module: MLX Swift official runtime (A3-1 translation probe)
scope: real translation via MLX generate(), same prompt/chat-template/sampling as D-1
backend: mlx-swift-lm HunyuanModel (research probe only, NOT wired into HymnTranslate)

cases.input: 机器学习正在改变世界。
cases.mlx_translation: Machine learning is changing the world.
cases.d1_translation: Machine learning is changing the world.

note: First case includes one-time MLX kernel warmup (prompt_ms 4086.4). Second case is steady-state. All values are single-run measurements, NOT averaged benchmarks; not comparable to D-1 TTFT/tokens-per-second figures.
translation_comparison: semantically equivalent; en->zh differs only in polite form (你 vs 您), zh->en byte-identical. Expected from different weight precision paths (MLX bf16 dequant vs D-1 fp16 cache) and different sampler implementations.
